name: The Saint's Price: What SNT Costs at Every Level
author: Anonymous fixer's handbook, circulated in the Gray Zone
body:
You want chrome. Everyone wants chrome. Here's what the Saint costs, depending on how much risk you're willing to eat.

TIER 1 — CORPORATE CLINIC (Φ2,400/cm²):
Genuine Gen 7 SNT. Licensed surgeon. Sterile facility. 2-year warranty. Post-op monitoring. 99.4% success rate. You'll spend Φ800K+ for a standard limb and you'll be paying it off for a decade. But it works. It always works.

TIER 2 — LICENSED INDEPENDENT (Φ1,800/cm²):
Genuine Gen 7, purchased through secondary market. Qualified surgeon, independent practice. Clean facility. No warranty. Success rate: 98%. This is the sweet spot for anyone with money but not corpo money.

TIER 3 — PREMIUM RIPPER (Φ600-900/cm²):
Gen 6-7 SNT, verified by the ripper personally. Former corpo surgeon or equivalent skill. Clean room, real equipment. Follow-up care. Success rate: 95-97%. This is where the smart money goes in the Gray Zone.

TIER 4 — STANDARD RIPPER (Φ200-500/cm²):
Gen 5-6 SNT, probably. Competent surgeon, variable facility. Basic post-op. Success rate: 88-93%. The risk is real but most people walk out working. Most.

TIER 5 — BUDGET RIPPER (Φ80-200/cm²):
SNT of unknown generation and origin. Surgeon of unknown qualification. Facility that may be a converted bathroom. No follow-up. Success rate: 75-85%. This is where the desperate go. One in five has problems. One in ten has serious problems. One in twenty dies.

TIER 6 — SELF-INSTALL (cost of materials only):
Don't. I know you're thinking about it. Don't. The SNT needs to be applied under surgical conditions. The neural bridge formation requires precise placement. Doing this yourself is like performing your own brain surgery while looking in a mirror. People try. People die.

The Saint doesn't care about your budget. The Saint cares about quality. Buy the best you can afford and then buy one tier above that. Your body is the only one you get.
